sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

reply.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Over many years, Demo Gießerei GmbH and Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH have built a deeply valued relationship grounded in mutual trust and shared values. We have carefully reviewed your proposed terms for a 24-month contract and a 60-day payment period. In the spirit of our long-standing cooperation, we are prepared to accept these extended terms. 

To accommodate this structure, we can offer a revised unit price of €52.30. Our full Angebot stands at a price of €52.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We take great pride in our craft and in serving long-standing partners like you. We look forward to continuing our successful work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
